title: 'The Palace of Secrets' release on Netflix on 22 January
summary: Starring Carla Campra and Carlos Cuevas
body_markdown:
Entertainment


16 November 2026


Global


Link copied to clipboard


[Download the video of the announcement](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/Download%20the%20video%20of%20the%20announcement%20Discover%20the%20first%20look)


[Discover the first look](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/3f0bd653-33d9-48f4-a175-3e79b8d12a72)


Netflix has today revealed the release date and first look from


The Palace of Secrets


. The series is based on the adaptation of the novel of the same name by


Estefanía Ruiz


, published by


Penguin Random House


, and will premiere globally on


Netflix on 22 January 2027.


Starring


Carla Campra


(


Holy Family


,


Dangerous Moms


) and


Carlos Cuevas


(


Smiley, The 47


), who will play Julia and Gonzalo respectively. Rounding out the cast are


Alberto Olmo


(


Bad Influence


),


Luís Bermejo


(


Magical Girl


),


María Morales


(


La bola negra


),


Roberto Álamo


(


May God Save Us


),


Bea Segura


(


Terra Alta


),


Helena Ezquerro


(


La Moderna


),


Nora Hernández


(


The Dinner


) and


Nico Romero


(


Cable Girls


),


Cristina Plazas


(


Locked Up


),


Karina Soro


(


UPA Next


),


Guillermo Toledo


(


The Last Night at Tremore Beach


),


Irene Montalà


(


City of Shadows


) and


Catalina del Rosario


(


Privilèges


), amongst others.


In the series, Julia Ponce (


Carla Campra


), daughter of the court painter, arrives at the royal palace and is captivated by its dazzling atmosphere. There she meets Gonzalo (


Carlos Cuevas


), the crown prince, who has returned to Spain, compelled by the king, to get married. Julia and Gonzalo’s impossible and forbidden relationship sparks intrigue, jealousy and passion in a court rife with ambition, deceit and revenge. Parties, clandestine trysts, a secret society of women plotting for power… And, in the midst of it all, Julia and Gonzalo struggle to live out their love.


Created by


Carlos de Pando


and


Sara Antuña


,


The Palace of Secrets


which


Zeta Studios


(


Olympo


,


Élite


) is producing for Netflix, is directed by


Paco Caballero


,


Jota Linares


and


Elena Trapé


.


Antonio Asensio


is the producer, and


Xavi Toll


and


Margarita Huguet


serve as executive producers of the series alongside Carlos and Sara.


About Zeta Studios


ZETA STUDIOS was founded with the aim of designing, creating and producing fiction content for the leading platforms and content distribution and exhibition markets. Among its projects, notable productions include the series


Olympo


,


When No One Sees Us


and


The Short Life


, and the films


Go Team


and


Love & Revolution


. Currently in production are the films


Marcelo in the Real World


,


Impunidad


and the series


Mataleón


.


Iciar Picardo


Publicity Specialist
